candidates.description: Competitive Binding Assay: Competitive binding assays were performed by incubating rhER alpha (α) and beta 1 (β1) receptors with 10 nM [3H]estradiol (the radio ligand) in the presence or absence of increasing concentrations, 0.25 to 250,000 nM, of the phenolic test compounds of Tables 1 to 3 (nM is nano molar). Each data point is the average of at least two assays. Stock solutions of the compounds of Tables 1 to 3 were prepared at 10×E-2 M in 100% ethanol, water or DMSO (dimethyl sulfoxide). Compounds were diluted 10 fold in binding buffer and then 1:4 in the final assay mix. The final concentration of ethanol or DMSO in the assay well was 5%. The highest concentration of the hydrolysis test compound was 2.5×E-4 M (250,000 nM). The residual monomers of Tables 1 to 3 were tested at seven concentrations over log increments. The lowest concentration was 2.5×E-10 M (0.25 nM).

Binding Assay: The competition assay was performed in a 96-well plate (polystyrene*) which binds <2.0% of the total input [3H]-17beta-estradiol and each data point was gathered in triplicate. 100 uG/100 uL of the receptor preparation was aliquoted per well. A saturating dose of 2.5 nM [3H]17beta-estradiol+competitor (or buffer) in a 50 uL volume was added in the preliminary competition when 100x and 500x competitor were evaluated, only 0.8 nM [3H]17beta-estradiol was used. The plate was incubated at room temperature for 2.5 h. At the end of this incubation period 150 uL of ice-cold dextran coated charcoal (5% activated charcoal coated with 0.05% 69K dextran) was added to each well and the plate was immediately centrifuged at 99 g for 5 minutes at 4 C. 200 uL of the supernatant solution was then removed for scintillation counting. Samples were counted to 2% or 10 minutes, whichever occurs first.
Binding affinity to ERalpha (unknown origin) assessed as inhibition constant
Binding affinity to ERalpha (unknown origin) by LanthaScreen TR-FRET competitive binding assay

experimental_gate: Original protocol must identify human ERalpha orthosteric ligand competition, receptor construct/species and appropriate absolute Ki/Kd/IC50. Unknown or mixed columns remain unresolved. No pooling.
next_stage: Commit a finite detailed-source acquisition declaration after method review and before activity-resource requests.
scope: Original-method review of the six capacity survivors without explicit metadata warnings, in fixed descending-capacity order. No activity-resource, compound/structure or scoring requests.

source_review_policy.allowed: Official document/assay metadata, original patents, articles and supplements; retain original response bytes and failures.
source_review_policy.incidental_exposure: Full source documents may contain compound structures/names or potency tables. Flag retained documents as potentially value-exposed, record actually inspected data sections, never call them unseen or omit adverse observations. Do not calculate new class counts in this stage.
source_review_policy.selection: Review methods in the declared order, regardless of visible class balance; no query/scoring changes. A later detailed-source declaration must preserve this review and exposure.
source_review_policy.unavailable: Record unavailable or ambiguous sources; do not replace candidates, infer species or treat retrieval failure as experimental rejection.

unchanged: Original fixed queries, thresholds, endpoints, twenty groups/class, no-pooling and complete historical exposure remain. MolSysMT owns later molecular identity/scaffold/preparation.
